description: Put a dish on the household's wish list, or add a vote when it is already there. A wish lifts the dish in the next planned week; it is a weight, never a rule. A title from get_recipes gives that recipe; any other name is kept as said.

memberName.description: The member the wish is for when someone wishes on a child's behalf; omit for the speaker's own wish.

title.description: The dish: its exact cookbook title when it is in the cookbook, else the user's own words, e.g. 'pannekaker'.

name: wish_dish
title: Wish for a dish
